name: pi-dev-cycle
description: Orchestrates a BMAD story implementation/review loop: implementer runs pi-dev-story (including targeted tests and lint quality gates), reviewer-a and reviewer-b run independent pi-code-review-style passes with quality-gate verification in parallel, findings are deduplicated into the story file, and the loop repeats until done or the configured iteration cap is reached (default 5, range 1..5). Dev-provided quality evidence is required before review dispatch. Use when the user says to run a pi-dev-cycle for a story folder or story file.
author: CanVc
